value: For a dwelling the landlord may require a deposit of no more than two months' rent (Art. 13).
source_publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda, Hábitat y Edificaciones (MIVHED), copy of Law No. 85-25, Gaceta Oficial No. 11211 of 15 August 2025

value: By agreement of the parties the deposit, with a copy of the lease, may be lodged at the Banco Agrícola or Banco de Reservas branch for the property's location; the bank pays savings-account interest that accrues to the deposit (Art. 15).
source_publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda, Hábitat y Edificaciones (MIVHED), copy of Law No. 85-25, Gaceta Oficial No. 11211 of 15 August 2025
note: Law No. 85-25 on Rental of Real Property and Evictions (Gaceta Oficial No. 11211, 15 August 2025), which repealed Law 4314 of 1955, Law 17-88 and Decree 4807 of 1959. Text read on the official MIVHED site on the check date.

value: After the property is handed back as agreed, the landlord returns the deposit or authorises the tenant in writing to withdraw it; any retention must be explained to the tenant in writing within five calendar days of getting the property back, with evidence such as photos and repair quotes; disputes go to the justice of the peace (Arts. 16 and 18).
source_publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda, Hábitat y Edificaciones (MIVHED), copy of Law No. 85-25, Gaceta Oficial No. 11211 of 15 August 2025

value: Rent adjustment is set by agreement; for a dwelling where no adjustment was expressly agreed, it may not exceed 10% of the rent (Art. 8).
source_publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda, Hábitat y Edificaciones (MIVHED), copy of Law No. 85-25, Gaceta Oficial No. 11211 of 15 August 2025

value: The parties set the term; the lease renews automatically if neither party states it will not renew, on the same conditions and for the same period; a verbal residential lease is presumed to be for at least one year (Art. 9).

value: To recover the property at the end of the term, notice served by bailiff must be given at least 90 calendar days before the term ends (Art. 31).

value: The landlord or the tenant registers the lease at the Civil Registry and Mortgage Office of the municipality where the property is, so that it can be relied on against third parties (Art. 14).

value: The landlord must hand over the dwelling habitable and in good condition, guarantee peaceful use for the whole lease, not disturb the tenant, and carry out necessary maintenance repairs without raising the rent for that reason during the current term (Arts. 19-20).
